display.title: Episode 420: The Mystery of Toras Emes, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Right after Purim: keeping Avraham's chesed and Purim's joy all year, saying the Shema clearly like dialing the right number, and chapter 1 of The Mystery of Toras Emes.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the Tuesday after Purim 5750. Uncle Yossi teaches that the kindness of mishloach manos and matanos la'evyonim should last all year: chesed is our inheritance from Avraham Avinu and Sarah Imeinu, who fed travelers in their tent and taught them that the food came from Hashem, bringing the world to believe in Him. Purim's simcha, too, should stay with us every day. After the Hakochainik march, Mitzvah Time reviews Kabbalas ol malchus Shamayim and shares a lesson in the spirit of the Baal Shem Tov's teaching to learn from everything: davening is like a telephone call, so we must say each word of the Shema clearly to 'dial the right number', and Hashem's line is never busy. A young listener answers quiz questions by phone and leads the Shema, his father thanks the program, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins a tale that echoes Purim: a kind king whom the Jews greet with a Sefer Torah, and a jealous officer who comes to the shul's shammes with a sly plan. The chapter ends on a cliffhanger, followed by candle-lighting time and a sponsor message.
display.lesson: Keep the kindness and joy of Purim all year long, and say every word of the Shema clearly so your tefillah reaches Hashem.
